segments.name: Land banking
products: Development loans secured by residential property
segments.description: Purchases and develops residential land and sells finished homesites to homebuilders through option contracts, providing an asset-light land banking solution.
segments.evidence: We have one reportable segment that derives revenue primarily from our portfolio of homesites under option contracts.

revenueModel.text: Homebuilders pay recurring cash option fees under option contracts for finished homesites, and borrowers pay interest on development loans secured by residential property.
revenueModel.evidence: Our option contracts provide for the payment of recurring cash option fees as compensation for the capital and operational solution delivered by the Millrose platform.

changes.text: In 2025, Millrose completed its Spin-Off from Lennar and became an independent, publicly traded company.
changes.evidence: On February 7, 2025, we completed our Spin-Off from Lennar through a distribution of approximately 80% of our Common Stock to holders of Lennar common stock as of the close of business on January 21, 2025.
